title: UK Visa Routes Decoded
subtitle: Visas, entry rules and every legal route into the United Kingdom, step by step
description:
A plain-language guide to every legal route into the United Kingdom, written by the Naara Family.

This first part explains how UK immigration works and who can help, gives you a route comparison chart and a decision tree, and sets out what each route costs, how long decisions take and the money you must show. Every figure carries the date it was checked, and where a fact could not be confirmed from an official source it says so.

General information, not legal or immigration advice.
